title: The image ships a specific, tested Octave Web release
description: Serves "Installing is boring.". The owner: jellyscale ships a specific tested Octave Web release (D-141), so a fresh install opens in a browser with nothing copied in. Octave Web is Octave's product, released on its own schedule.
acceptanceCriteria: The image carries a specific Octave Web release, pinned in one place and changed only by a commit, with Octave's licence notice and where its source is (D-142).
Observed first, on the dogfood's films: how many Octave Web plays as they are and how many need converting, and the worker cores that holds; docs/running.md's sizing states it.

The published image, with no webDir set, serves the pinned build at `/` with deep links, cache headers, precompressed assets and a CSP; in the e2e tier a browser signs in, browses and plays against the image as published.
docs/status.md lists, per browser (desktop Chrome, Firefox, Safari; iPhone, iPad), whether Octave's project measured it playing, or 'not known'.

docs/running.md: which build ships, how to replace it, how to turn it off; the quick start copies nothing; image size before and after; docs/access.md states the served paths are open and carry no Access-Control-* header; the served pages set no cookie of their own.
The shipped Octave Web release signs in with jellyscale's web sign-in (JS-215).
Before a jellyscale release ships an Octave Web release, that release passes jellyscale's browser check against the image (sign in, browse, play, seek, resume).
source: issue #221; owner, 2026-11-20; PRODUCT.md operator: Installing is boring; goal 3
notes: Cross-project need (D-132): an Octave Web release built on jellyscale's API (ASK-6).
